~ Repair Instructions for Imperial Raxis Prime and the Death Star ~

This is meant as a repair for the no music / no sound effects glitch in the PC version.  The fix involves replacing four files in the program's folder.  If you wish you can rename the existing files by adding .bak AFTER the file extension. 

(EXAMPLE: somefile.exe to somefile.exe.bak)

The files you need to rename are:

cp_rx2.st.nv.pcp
cp_rx2.st.nv.pcd
cp_dsa.st.nv.pcp
cp_dsa.st.nv.pcd

Those files can be found inside your steam directory here:

..\Steam\steamapps\common\star wars the force unleashed\LevelPacks\

The replacement files can be downloaded via FileFactory from this link:

http://www.filefactory.com/file/3nnh1hpxz3o7/SWTFU_Fixed_Files.7z

Or from my Google Drive if the above link stops working:

http://bit.ly/1tTvIyf

If that link goes down, send me a message here on YouTube and I'll email the files to you.  I am archiving a copy of them with my videos.

Credit for this fix goes to Sweetz who posted this fix in the steam forums here:

http://forums.steampowered.com/forums/showthread.php?t=1481323
